finding.claim: AuthenticationMiddleware skips auth for any path starting with '/nodes', and the proxy installs this middleware on an app that exposes /nodes/add, /nodes/remove, /nodes/terminate and GET /nodes/terminate_all. When api_keys is set on the proxy, these operator endpoints are reachable without a token.
finding.source: Unauthenticated HTTP request to /nodes/* on the proxy (no credential required)
finding.sink: node_manager.add/remove/terminate_node/terminate_all_nodes (lmdeploy/serve/proxy/proxy.py:152,180,187,210), which send GET {node}/terminate to backend nodes (proxy.py:194,227)

trace.note: skip_prefixes includes '/nodes'
url_path.startswith(path) short-circuits verify_token for /nodes/*
AuthenticationMiddleware installed on proxy app when api_keys set
/nodes/terminate route gated only by validate_json_request
GET /nodes/terminate_all gated only by validate_json_request
validate_json_request checks content-type only, not auth

finding.guards_checked: AuthenticationMiddleware present but prefix exemption covers all /nodes routes; validate_json_request is a content-type check only; no per-route auth on /nodes routes. Exemption is documented as intended for node registration (api_server.py:124-136), but it also covers remove/terminate/terminate_all.

finding.claim: /nodes/add accepts an arbitrary node URL with no validation; the proxy then forwards /v1 client requests, including the client's Authorization header, to that node. A registered attacker-controlled node receives client bearer tokens and prompt/response data. Chains with F1 when the proxy has api_keys set.
finding.source: Node.url in the POST /nodes/add body (lmdeploy/serve/proxy/proxy.py:57), unauthenticated per F1 when api_keys set
finding.sink: Forwarded request target_url = node_url + endpoint (proxy.py:386) with headers from _prepare_headers (proxy.py:387,451), which copies all client headers except Host

trace.note: Node.url: str, no validation
/nodes/add calls node_manager.add(node.url, node.status)
if status.models != [] node is stored directly without contacting the URL
otherwise APIClient(api_server_url=node_url) fetches /v1/models from the URL
target_url = node_url.rstrip('/') + endpoint
_prepare_headers copies Authorization and all other client headers

finding.guards_checked: No scheme, host, or IP validation on node URL. The IP filter in lmdeploy/vl/media/connection.py applies only to media fetches. No credential check on /nodes/add beyond F1. Headers forwarded unchanged.

finding.claim: The multimodal loader accepts local filesystem paths and file:// URLs from chat content and reads them from the server filesystem. The allowed_media_domains allowlist is applied only to the HTTP branch, so it does not restrict local reads.
finding.source: String image_url / video_url / audio_url / time_series_url in a chat message content item (lmdeploy/serve/processors/multimodal.py:161-164)
finding.sink: open(file_path,'rb') in ImageMediaIO.load_file (lmdeploy/vl/media/image.py:32), reached via _load_file_url (connection.py:115) and media_io.load_file

trace.note: data_src is a str, passed to load_from_url
urlparse(url) with no scheme restriction on the file branch
file scheme or os.path.exists(url) or os.path.exists(url_spec.path) selects the file branch
Path(url2pathname(netloc+path))
open() on attacker-chosen path; contents parsed by PIL

finding.guards_checked: /v1 auth middleware applies only when api_keys is configured. allowed_media_domains is checked only in the HTTP branch (connection.py:75). Files must decode as image/video/audio/time-series to succeed; output reaches the caller only through model output, so exfiltration is limited and not directly confirmed.

finding.claim: The HTTP media fetch has a DNS-rebinding TOCTOU: _is_safe_url resolves the hostname and checks is_global, then requests re-resolves the hostname at fetch time. A short-TTL record can pass the check with a public address and connect to an internal address.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled image_url hostname whose DNS answer changes between the two lookups
finding.sink: client.get(parsed.url, ...) at connection.py:83 (internal network reach, SSRF)

trace.note: _is_safe_url(parsed.url) resolves via getaddrinfo and checks ip.is_global
_is_safe_url definition, resolution at lines 40-50
requests.Session.get re-resolves the hostname independently
redirects are re-validated per hop, so only the rebinding race remains

finding.guards_checked: allow_redirects=False; per-hop validation of redirects; is_global check on all resolved addresses; allowed_media_domains allowlist (opt-in, default None so no allowlist by default). Response is decoded as media, so the attack is mostly blind.
